# Mastermind — www.mastermind-x.com

> Mastermind is a market-intelligence platform: nightly-computed macro regime, market-cycle, and sector-rotation dashboards across US, China, Hong Kong, Canada and global markets, plus per-stock dossiers with proprietary trend, stage and confluence models. Bilingual English/Chinese at every URL. Signals and scores come from deterministic engines over market data; AI assists explanation, not signal generation.

Machine-readable brand facts: https://www.mastermind-x.com/brand-facts.json
Sitemap: https://www.mastermind-x.com/sitemap.xml

## Public, citable surfaces
- [Stock Dossiers](https://www.mastermind-x.com/stocks/index.html): 1,600+ per-ticker pages — trend, stage, confluence, ownership and options context.
- [Research Library](https://www.mastermind-x.com/research/): public report landing pages and excerpts; full reports may require a subscription.
- [Learning Center](https://www.mastermind-x.com/learn/index.html): technical analysis, position sizing, options mechanics and market breadth.
- [Trading Calculators](https://www.mastermind-x.com/tools/index.html): risk, return, sizing and portfolio calculators.
- [Mastermind Blog](https://www.mastermind-x.com/blog/index.html): plain-English articles on trading math, risk and market mechanics.

## Product access
- The live regional dashboards, ranked boards, Neural Web and premium signal detail require an account. Start at [Mastermind](https://www.mastermind-x.com/) or review [Plans](https://www.mastermind-x.com/plans.html).
- Public stock dossiers update after the relevant market close. Each page carries its own freshness and limitation labels.

## Free tools & learning
- [Trading Calculators](https://www.mastermind-x.com/tools/index.html): position sizing, risk/reward, compounding, CAGR, drawdown recovery — free, no sign-in.
- [Learning Center](https://www.mastermind-x.com/learn/index.html): structured lessons on technical analysis, position sizing, and reading insider filings.
- [Blog](https://www.mastermind-x.com/blog/index.html): plain-English articles on trading math, risk, and market mechanics.
- [Trading Journal Spreadsheet](https://www.mastermind-x.com/tools/spreadsheets/trading-journal.html): free Excel/Google Sheets template for tracking trades and reviewing performance.
